summary_en: ARTNATURE will acquire up to 420,000 shares (1.26% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for up to ¥350 million through a single ToSTNeT-3 off-hours block transaction on November 16, 2026 at ¥762 per share, the closing price on November 13, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Block Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, ARTNATURE's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 420,000 shares of common stock for a maximum of ¥350 million through a single off-hours block transaction (ToSTNeT-3) on November 16, 2026. The acquisition will be executed at ¥762 per share, representing the closing price (including final special quotation) on November 13, 2026. The purchase order is limited to the trading session on November 16 at 8:45 a.m. Japan Standard Time.

The maximum share count of 420,000 represents 1.26% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. As of November 13, 2026, the company held 1,064,340 treasury shares, with 33,328,860 shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock).

The company stated the acquisition is intended to execute flexible capital policy in response to changes in the business environment. The acquisition will be announced after the trading session concludes. There is a possibility that part or all of the intended acquisition may not be executed depending on market conditions.
